analyzed_vuln.description: `parseResources()` constructs a `DnsResource` at `offsetInPacket` and immediately advances `offsetInPacket` by `newResource->getSize()`. `getSize()` calls `DnsResource::getDataLength()`, which reads the 2-byte RDLENGTH field from packet bytes. This read happens before `parseResources()` verifies the resource fits in `m_DataLen`, so for a truncated DNS RR near the end of the buffer, `getDataLength()` performs an out-of-bounds read (heap-buffer-overflow). Root cause is premature size computation on unvalidated packet offsets in `parseResources()` (crash manifests in `DnsResource::getDataLength()`).
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Fuzzer input must produce a UDP packet parsed as DNS where DNS header resource counts cause `parseResources()` to iterate into a resource whose fixed RR header (name/type/class/ttl/rdlength) is not fully present at the current offset. During `newResource->getSize()` the code reads RDLENGTH from beyond packet end before bounds check (`if (offsetInPacket > m_DataLen)`) runs, triggering a 2-byte OOB read.
